title: RPP-4f MATERIAL specular map generated fast slice
mode: Local implementation and generated ASCII/Binary validation

typedModel: DRW_Material retains specular map scalar/string controls and a 16-element row-major transform with documented defaults and individual presence flags.
Specular filename has its own retained-text lease field; transform parsing has independent cardinality state from diffuse group 43.
Copy/reset behavior preserves the map and restores defaults with presence false.
parser: Type groups 46/77/4/78/79/170/47 only before the post-map 464/465 boundary.
Validate finite blend and matrix reals, source/projection/tiling domains, and the documented auto-transform flag mask.
Require exactly 16 contiguous matrix reals; reject incomplete matrices at the next group and reject excess values immediately.
Preserve later Normal Map groups and other untyped MATERIAL properties in the ordered raw net.
writer: Emit groups 46/77/4/78/79/170 followed by all 16 group-47 row-major values when present.
Reject invalid authored domains and non-finite map data before output replacement.
boundedTextRegression: The focused MATERIAL retained-owner CTest checks exact-cap specular filename replacement in ASCII and Binary DXF.
At one byte under the cap, the previous filename remains intact; copy/reset accounting releases the shared lease correctly.

generatedControls: ASCII and Binary MATERIAL records carry distinct specular-map values and a non-identity 16-value matrix, followed by a LINE sentinel.
Assert typed field values, explicit defaults/presence, copy/reset behavior, exact raw group order, same-encoding replay, and ASCII/Binary cross-encoding replay.
Reject invalid source, projection, tiling, auto-transform mask, non-finite ASCII blend, and 15-/17-value mapper matrices before callback publication.
Typed writer round-trips all fields and asserts schema order; invalid scalar domains and non-finite matrix data preserve existing output and succeed after correction.
No persistent test drawing is added; malformed ASCII numeric values are applied only to locally generated temporary files.
